query:
SELECT stage, COUNT(*) as count, 
  SUM(CAST(quotedAmount AS DECIMAL(10,2))) as total_quoted,
  SUM(CAST(retainerBooked AS DECIMAL(10,2))) as total_retainer
FROM leads
GROUP BY stage
ORDER BY count DESC;
